lessons.lessonTitle: Lesson 1: Bootstrap 5 Grid System & Responsive Utilities

questions.question: What was one of the most notable architectural changes introduced in Bootstrap 5 compared to Bootstrap 4?
options: Replacing all HTML5 tags with React JSX components
Completely dropping the jQuery dependency in favor of modern vanilla JavaScript
Removing the 12-column grid system in favor of table layouts
Requiring all stylesheets to be written in Python
questions.explanation: Bootstrap 5 eliminated the dependency on jQuery, rewritten completely in native vanilla JavaScript with improved performance and smaller bundle sizes.

questions.question: What is the primary difference between `.container` and `.container-fluid` in Bootstrap 5?
options: `.container` has a fixed responsive max-width at each breakpoint tier, while `.container-fluid` always spans 100% width across all viewport sizes
`.container-fluid` converts all child elements into SVG vector graphics
`.container` automatically removes all margin and padding gutters
`.container-fluid` only works on desktop monitors, while `.container` is mobile-only
questions.explanation: `.container` adjusts max-width at each breakpoint (`sm`, `md`, `lg`, `xl`, `xxl`), while `.container-fluid` continuously occupies 100% width across all viewports.

questions.question: What are the 6 standard responsive breakpoint tiers in Bootstrap 5?
questions.explanation: Bootstrap 5 features 6 responsive tiers: `xs` (default <576px), `sm` (576px), `md` (768px), `lg` (992px), `xl` (1200px), and the new `xxl` (1400px).

questions.question: In the Bootstrap 5 12-column grid system, what is the mandatory parent-child hierarchy rule?
options: Columns must be placed directly inside `<main>` without `.container` or `.row`
Containers (`.container`) wrap Rows (`.row`), and Rows must be the immediate parents of Columns (`.col-*`)
Rows can be placed directly inside other Rows without any columns
Columns must wrap Rows, which in turn wrap Containers
questions.explanation: Bootstrap's grid hierarchy strictly requires `.container` (or `.container-fluid`) -> `.row` -> `.col-*` so margins, paddings, and negative row margins calculate correctly.

questions.question: How do you create a column layout that stacks vertically as 100% width on mobile screens, splits into 2 equal columns on tablets (≥768px), and 4 equal columns on desktops (≥992px)?
questions.explanation: In a 12-column grid: `col-12` = 100% width, `col-md-6` = 6/12 (50% or 2 per row), and `col-lg-3` = 3/12 (25% or 4 per row).

questions.question: What does the `.col-auto` class do on a grid column in Bootstrap 5?
options: It randomly assigns a column width between 1 and 12
It sizes the column to fit the natural intrinsic width of its inner content
It hides the column automatically when other columns are clicked
It automatically expands the column to 100% width on all screens
questions.explanation: `.col-auto` sets column width based on content size (`width: auto`), allowing adjacent columns with `.col` to fill the remaining available space.

questions.question: Which utility class is used to shift a column 3 grid columns to the right on medium screens (≥768px)?
questions.explanation: `.offset-md-3` applies `margin-left: 25%` (3/12 columns) at the `md` breakpoint to offset the column horizontally.

questions.question: Which Bootstrap 5 gutter classes set a horizontal column gutter of size 3 and vertical row gutter of size 4 on a `.row`?
questions.explanation: Bootstrap 5 uses `.gx-*` for horizontal gutters (column padding/negative row margins) and `.gy-*` for vertical row gutters between stacked items.

questions.question: What does the shorthand class `.row-cols-md-3` placed on a `.row` accomplish?
options: It sets the font size to 3rem across the entire row
It limits the maximum number of items in the database to 3
It automatically formats all immediate child `.col` elements into 3 equal columns per row on medium screens (≥768px) without needing `col-md-4` on every child
It creates exactly 3 empty rows in the DOM tree
questions.explanation: `.row-cols-*` sets how many columns appear per row at the container level, dynamically wrapping children into rows of 3 on `md` screens.

questions.question: Which utility class in Bootstrap 5 applies a margin-top of 4 and margin-bottom of 4 simultaneously?
questions.explanation: In Bootstrap spacing notation, `y` represents the vertical axis (`top` and `bottom`), so `my-4` sets both `margin-top` and `margin-bottom` to spacing scale 4.

questions.question: How do you hide an element on mobile screens (<768px) and display it as a flexbox container on tablets and desktops (≥768px) using Bootstrap 5 utility classes?
questions.explanation: `d-none` hides the element as base style, and `d-md-flex` applies `display: flex` starting at the `md` (≥768px) breakpoint tier.

questions.question: Which class centers text horizontally on mobile and aligns text to the left on medium screens (≥768px)?
questions.explanation: Bootstrap 5 uses direction keywords: `start` for left (in LTR mode) and `end` for right, combined with responsive prefixes (e.g., `text-center text-md-start`).

questions.question: What is the effect of applying `.rounded-pill` to a button or badge element?
options: It makes the button pulse continuously with CSS animations
It applies a 3D bevel and inset shadow effect
It turns the element into a circular 100px icon
It applies a large border-radius (50rem) to create fully rounded stadium/pill shaped ends
questions.explanation: `.rounded-pill` sets `border-radius: 50rem`, creating smooth, oblong pill shapes for buttons, badges, and tags.

questions.question: Which utility combination centers an element both horizontally and vertically inside a relative parent container?
questions.explanation: `top-50 start-50` positions the element at 50% from top and left, while `translate-middle` applies `transform: translate(-50%, -50%)` to center it perfectly.

questions.question: What does the `.text-truncate` class do when applied to a block element with a constrained width?
options: It deletes all vowels from the text to save space
It hides the entire paragraph from the screen
It shrinks the font size to 8px automatically
It prevents text wrapping and truncates overflowing text with an ellipsis (`...`)
questions.explanation: `.text-truncate` combines `overflow: hidden; text-overflow: ellipsis; white-space: nowrap;` for clean single-line truncation.

questions.question: Which class in Bootstrap 5 applies a large, elevated drop shadow to a card or container?
questions.explanation: Bootstrap provides 4 shadow utilities: `shadow-none`, `shadow-sm`, `shadow` (regular), and `shadow-lg` (large elevation).

questions.question: How do you apply a 50% transparent dark background color to a container using Bootstrap 5 utility classes?
questions.explanation: Bootstrap 5 uses CSS variable opacity helpers: `bg-dark bg-opacity-50` sets the background color while setting `--bs-bg-opacity: 0.5` without altering text opacity.

questions.question: Which utility class aligns flex items to the vertical center of a flex container?
questions.explanation: `align-items-center` applies `align-items: center` to align children along the cross axis (vertical in row mode).

questions.question: What class is used to float an element to the right in Bootstrap 5 (supporting LTR and RTL directions)?
questions.explanation: Bootstrap 5 replaced directional `float-left`/`float-right` with `float-start` and `float-end` to support bidirectional LTR/RTL layouts.

questions.question: What is the effect of setting `.g-0` on a `.row` element?
options: It adds 0px padding inside text elements
It forces the row to occupy zero height
It removes all horizontal column gutters and negative row margins completely
It limits the row to 0 columns
questions.explanation: `.g-0` eliminates all gutter spacing between columns and removes the negative margin on `.row`, creating flush grid layouts.

lessons.lessonTitle: Lesson 2: Bootstrap Components (Navbar, Modals, Cards, Forms)

questions.question: What is the role of the `.navbar-toggler` button in a Bootstrap 5 navigation bar?
options: It submits the navigation search form to the backend server
It acts as the hamburger toggle button that expands or collapses the mobile navigation menu via `data-bs-toggle="collapse"`
It toggles between dark mode and light mode themes
It rotates the brand logo 360 degrees
questions.explanation: `.navbar-toggler` renders the mobile hamburger button, triggering the collapsible navigation container (`.collapse.navbar-collapse`).

questions.question: Which class on a `.navbar` specifies that the navigation links should collapse into a hamburger menu on screens narrower than large desktops (≥992px)?
questions.explanation: `.navbar-expand-lg` keeps the navbar expanded horizontally on `lg` screens (≥992px) and collapses it into a mobile accordion/hamburger on smaller screens.

questions.question: What is the standard HTML structure for a basic Bootstrap 5 Card component?
questions.explanation: Bootstrap Cards use a modular structure: `.card` encapsulating `.card-header`, `.card-body` (with `.card-title`, `.card-subtitle`, `.card-text`), and `.card-footer`.

questions.question: Which data attributes are required on a button to trigger and open a Bootstrap 5 Modal dialog with `id="loginModal"`?
questions.explanation: Bootstrap 5 uses namespaced attributes: `data-bs-toggle="modal"` and `data-bs-target="#loginModal"` (the `bs` prefix distinguishes Bootstrap 5 from Bootstrap 4).

questions.question: How do you prevent a Bootstrap 5 Modal from closing when a user clicks outside the modal dialog backdrop?
questions.explanation: `data-bs-backdrop="static"` creates a static backdrop that does not close the modal when clicked, requiring users to explicitly click a close or submit button.

questions.question: Which class converts a standard text input into a modern Bootstrap 5 floating label form group?
questions.explanation: Wrapping an `<input>` with a defined `placeholder` and a matching `<label>` inside a `.form-floating` container creates smooth floating animated labels.

questions.question: How do you activate native Bootstrap 5 client-side form validation styles upon form submission?
options: Include jQuery validation plugin script before the `</body>` tag
Add the `.was-validated` class to the `<form class="needs-validation">` container via JavaScript
questions.explanation: Bootstrap validation works by applying `.was-validated` to a `.needs-validation` form, activating `:valid` and `:invalid` pseudoclasses and showing `.valid-feedback` / `.invalid-feedback`.

questions.question: Which class creates a toggleable, accessible Accordion component in Bootstrap 5?
questions.explanation: Bootstrap 5 Accordions use `.accordion` containing structured `.accordion-item` elements with `.accordion-button` toggles and `.accordion-collapse` collapsible bodies.

questions.question: What is the Offcanvas component in Bootstrap 5 primarily used for?
options: Compressing user uploaded image files in the browser
Building hidden sidebars (drawer menus, shopping carts, filters) that slide into view from the viewport edge
Exporting HTML tables directly to Microsoft Excel spreadsheets
Rendering 3D graphic animations using WebGL canvas
questions.explanation: The `.offcanvas` component builds slide-in drawer sidebars from the start, end, top, or bottom edges (`offcanvas-start`, `offcanvas-end`).

questions.question: Why do Bootstrap 5 Tooltips and Popovers require manual JavaScript initialization to work?
options: Tooltips require purchasing an enterprise license key
Tooltips only function when connected to a live WebSocket server
Because CSS does not support text rendering inside tooltips
For performance reasons, Tooltip and Popover components are opt-in and must be initialized via `new bootstrap.Tooltip(el)`
questions.explanation: Tooltips and Popovers rely on Popper.js for positioning and are opt-in for performance; developers must initialize them via JavaScript (e.g., `new bootstrap.Tooltip(element)`).

questions.question: Which class turns a checkbox into a modern iOS-style toggle switch in Bootstrap 5?
questions.explanation: Adding `.form-switch` alongside `.form-check` transforms standard checkbox inputs into toggle switches.

questions.question: How do you create an outline-styled danger (red) button in Bootstrap 5?
questions.explanation: `.btn-outline-{theme}` (e.g., `.btn-outline-danger`, `.btn-outline-primary`) renders buttons with transparent backgrounds and colored borders until hovered.

questions.question: What class makes a Bootstrap 5 Alert dismissible with a functional close button (`.btn-close`)?
options: alert alert-dismissible fade show (with `<button class="btn-close" data-bs-dismiss="alert"></button>`)
questions.explanation: `.alert-dismissible fade show` with `<button class="btn-close" data-bs-dismiss="alert">` creates a smooth fade-out dismissible alert.

questions.question: Which component is designed to render animated skeleton loading placeholders while data is being fetched from an API?
questions.explanation: Bootstrap 5 Placeholders (`.placeholder` with `.placeholder-glow` or `.placeholder-wave`) provide animated skeleton mockups for loading states.

questions.question: What class is used to center a modal vertically on the screen rather than pinning it to the top?
questions.explanation: Adding `.modal-dialog-centered` to `.modal-dialog` aligns the modal box to the exact vertical center of the viewport.

questions.question: How can you position a small notification badge count in the top-right corner of a button in Bootstrap 5?
options: Set `position-relative` on the `<button>` and `position-absolute top-0 start-100 translate-middle badge` on the `<span>`
Wrap the badge in a `<marquee>` tag
questions.explanation: Combining `position-relative` on the button with `position-absolute top-0 start-100 translate-middle` pins the badge directly over the top-right corner.

questions.question: Which class enables smooth horizontal scrolling within a table that overflows narrow viewports?
questions.explanation: Wrapping a table in `<div class="table-responsive">` (or `.table-responsive-md`) creates a horizontal scroll wrapper on smaller screens.

questions.question: What is the purpose of the `.carousel.slide` component in Bootstrap 5?
options: Managing multi-step form wizards with state
Creating an animated slideshow/carousel for cycling through images or text slides with controls and indicators
questions.explanation: The Carousel component (`.carousel.slide`) provides an automated image and content slider with previous/next controls and indicators.

questions.question: Which class makes a group of cards in a grid maintain identical uniform heights?
options: h-100 (applied to each `.card` within a `.row-cols-*` grid)
questions.explanation: Applying `.h-100` (`height: 100%`) to `.card` elements inside a flex/grid row forces all cards in that row to match the height of the tallest card.

questions.question: What is the `.btn-close` class in Bootstrap 5?
options: A standalone generic close icon button styled via CSS background SVG, used in modals, alerts, toasts, and offcanvas components
A class that hides all open dropdown menus across the entire page
A JavaScript function that terminates the user's browser session
A backend database connection closing utility
questions.explanation: `.btn-close` renders an accessible, styled SVG 'X' button used uniformly across dismissible alerts, modal headers, offcanvas sidebars, and toasts.

questions.question: How do you enable Dark Mode globally across an entire website in Bootstrap 5.3+?
options: Add the class `.dark-mode-all` to the `<body>` element
questions.explanation: Bootstrap 5.3+ introduced built-in color modes activated via the `data-bs-theme="dark"` (or `light`) attribute on `<html>` or individual component wrappers.

questions.question: How can you toggle between dark and light themes dynamically using JavaScript in Bootstrap 5.3+?
questions.explanation: Setting `data-bs-theme` on `document.documentElement` switches all Bootstrap CSS custom properties (`--bs-body-bg`, `--bs-body-color`, etc.) in real time.

questions.question: What is the primary recommended approach for deeply customizing Bootstrap themes, colors, and typography for enterprise applications?
options: Using JavaScript `element.style` modifications on every DOM node
Directly modifying the minified `bootstrap.min.css` file in `node_modules`
Customizing Bootstrap Sass source files (`.scss`) by overriding `$theme-colors` and default variables before compiling to CSS
Writing thousands of `!important` rules in a separate override CSS file
questions.explanation: Compiling Bootstrap from Sass allows modifying default variables (`$primary`, `$font-family-base`, `$theme-colors`) cleanly without bloat or `!important` specificity wars.

questions.question: Why do default Bootstrap Sass variables use the `!default` flag (e.g., `$primary: #0d6efd !default;`)?
options: It allows developers to define their own custom variable values first without Bootstrap's defaults overwriting them
It encrypts the variable value for security
It marks the variable as mandatory for browser rendering
It prevents the variable from being exported to CSS
questions.explanation: In Sass, `!default` assigns a value to a variable only if that variable has not already been declared, enabling effortless variable overrides.

questions.question: How do you add a custom theme color (e.g., 'accent': #e11d48) to Bootstrap's `$theme-colors` map in Sass?
questions.explanation: Merging custom colors into the `$theme-colors` map before importing Bootstrap generates all corresponding utilities (`btn-accent`, `bg-accent`, `text-accent`, etc.).

questions.question: What are CSS Custom Properties (CSS Variables) used for in Bootstrap 5 components?
options: They replace the need for HTML markup entirely
They store user session login tokens securely in the browser
They allow real-time runtime style modifications (like changing `--bs-btn-bg` or `--bs-primary`) directly in CSS without recompiling Sass
They validate HTML form inputs before network transmission
questions.explanation: Bootstrap 5 components expose root and component-level CSS variables (e.g., `--bs-primary`, `--bs-card-bg`), enabling dynamic live theming and color mode switching.

questions.question: What is the purpose of using a tool like PurgeCSS or UnCSS in a production build pipeline with Bootstrap?
options: To automatically fix spelling errors in HTML text content
To generate automatic dark mode images
To convert all CSS into WebAssembly machine code
To analyze HTML/JS files and remove unused Bootstrap CSS classes, shrinking production CSS bundle size by up to 80-90%
questions.explanation: PurgeCSS scans templates and purges unused selectors from the full Bootstrap stylesheet, reducing CSS bundles from ~200KB to ~15KB.

questions.question: What is the built-in Sass engine in Bootstrap that automatically scales font sizes smoothly across different screen dimensions?
questions.explanation: Bootstrap uses RFS (Responsive Font Sizing) to automatically calculate fluid font sizes using `clamp()` and media queries for headings and typography.

questions.question: How can you reduce the CSS bundle size when importing Bootstrap using Sass?
options: Disable CSS Grid inside the browser developer settings
Delete all comments inside HTML files manually
Change the file extension from `.scss` to `.txt`
Import only the specific component Sass partials needed (e.g., `@import "bootstrap/scss/buttons";`) instead of `@import "bootstrap/scss/bootstrap";`
questions.explanation: Modular Sass imports allow developers to bundle only required components (grid, buttons, navbar), eliminating unused components from the final CSS bundle.

questions.question: What does the Bootstrap 5 Utilities API in Sass allow developers to do?
options: Modify, extend, or generate brand new responsive utility classes (like custom opacity, spacing, or shadows) through the `$utilities` Sass map
Connect frontend forms directly to PostgreSQL databases
Generate backend REST API controllers automatically
Execute Python scripts directly inside the web browser
questions.explanation: The Utilities API in `_utilities.scss` allows adding new utility classes or customizing existing ones via a declarative Sass map structure.

questions.question: How do you enable Right-to-Left (RTL) text direction support in Bootstrap 5 for languages like Arabic or Hebrew?
options: Include a translation plugin script before `</body>`
Add `text-direction: reverse;` to all paragraph tags
Add `dir="rtl"` to `<html>` and include the RTLCSS compiled stylesheet (`bootstrap.rtl.min.css`)
questions.explanation: Bootstrap 5 natively supports RTL by using RTLCSS compiled builds (`bootstrap.rtl.css`) paired with `<html dir="rtl">`.

questions.question: Which file structure represents the standard best practice when compiling a custom Bootstrap Sass project?
options: A single inline `<style>` tag on every individual HTML page
questions.explanation: Defining variable overrides before importing Bootstrap Sass ensures custom variables take effect, followed by custom component overrides after Bootstrap imports.

questions.question: How do you customize the focus ring color on form inputs using Bootstrap Sass variables?
options: Focus ring colors cannot be customized in Bootstrap
Override `$input-focus-border-color` and `$input-btn-focus-box-shadow` in your custom variables file
Add `outline-color: red;` to all `<input>` tags in HTML
questions.explanation: Modifying `$input-focus-border-color` and `$input-btn-focus-box-shadow` changes the focus highlight styling across all form controls cleanly.

questions.question: What is the advantage of using Bootstrap Icons via SVG sprites (``) over an icon font (``)?
options: SVG sprites render sharper on high-DPI screens, load only required icons, and eliminate icon font flickering and render-blocking font downloads
SVG sprites can only be rendered on Apple macOS computers
Icon fonts consume 90% less CPU memory than SVG sprites
Icon fonts are the only format that supports color gradients
questions.explanation: Inline SVGs and SVG sprites provide superior rendering sharpness, accessibility, and performance compared to font-based icons.

questions.question: How can you scope Bootstrap 5 styles to a specific container (e.g., `#my-widget`) to prevent style leaks in a microfrontend application?
options: Wrap Bootstrap's Sass imports inside a CSS nesting selector in your Sass root file (e.g., `#my-widget { @import "bootstrap/scss/bootstrap"; }`)
Bootstrap styles cannot be scoped under any circumstances
Add `scoped="true"` to the `<link>` tag in HTML
Rename all Bootstrap classes with a random hash suffix manually
questions.explanation: Nesting Bootstrap imports inside a parent selector in Sass confines all generated styles to that specific container wrapper.

questions.question: What Sass map controls the maximum container widths at each breakpoint tier in Bootstrap 5?
questions.explanation: The `$container-max-widths` map specifies container max-width values for `sm`, `md`, `lg`, `xl`, and `xxl` tiers.

questions.question: How do you override a component-specific CSS variable for just one individual button without affecting other buttons?
options: Modify the global `$btn-padding-y` Sass variable in `_variables.scss`
Set `button:hover { all: unset; }` in global CSS
Apply custom inline CSS or a modifier class (e.g., `.btn-custom { --bs-btn-padding-y: 1.2rem; --bs-btn-bg: #8b5cf6; }`)
Delete the Bootstrap button stylesheet from the server
questions.explanation: Component-scoped CSS variables allow targeting single instances (e.g., `.btn-hero { --bs-btn-bg: #8b5cf6; }`) without affecting global button styles.

questions.question: What happens if a developer imports custom Sass variables AFTER `@import "bootstrap/scss/bootstrap";`?
options: The browser displays the webpage in black and white mode
The custom variables are ignored because Bootstrap's defaults have already been evaluated and assigned
The custom variables take precedence over everything automatically
The Sass compiler throws a fatal syntax error and crashes
questions.explanation: Because Bootstrap variables use `!default`, custom variables MUST be declared before importing Bootstrap; importing them after means Bootstrap has already assigned its defaults.

questions.question: Which Bootstrap 5 Sass variable controls the default body font family across the entire framework?
questions.explanation: Setting `$font-family-base: 'Inter', sans-serif !default;` updates the default typography font stack across all headings, buttons, and text elements.

questions.question: What is the recommended method for resolving a CSS specificity clash between Bootstrap utility classes and a custom component stylesheet?
options: Add `!important` to every single line of custom CSS
Set all element display properties to `inline`
Remove the `<DOCTYPE html>` tag from the HTML page
Ensure custom component CSS is loaded after Bootstrap and use proper selector specificity rather than scattering `!important` rules
questions.explanation: Maintaining clean stylesheet load order (Bootstrap first, custom styles second) and using structured component classes avoids messy `!important` anti-patterns.
